summary: Mikes Knob lookout built 1941 with CCC labor; relocated to Richwood VFD for preservation, not open to the public. Two sources give Greenbrier County instead of Pocahontas.

access.note: A 2024 blog post says the tower is not open to the public. It stands at a fire station, so ask the department before going near it

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and blog say Pocahontas County; Forest Lookouts and FFLA say Greenbrier. Not resolved here; the story reports both and the record keeps Pocahontas, the Register's value.

notes_for_editor: Both Register photos are already in the record, so no new photos. No staffing or fire history found. Access rests on a 2024 blog post; the Richwood VFD was not contacted. The county conflict (Pocahontas vs Greenbrier) should be checked against the Forest Service or the Richwood station if the editor wants it settled.
